tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Nvidia chief Jensen Huang was targeted in an alleged spy plot involving a Chinese businesswoman and a former Saudi OpenAI employee, still open per Semafor amid US-China artificial intelligence tensions.
Anthropic's new Claude Enterprise tools let organizations analyze usage, gather feedback, and share artificial intelligence budgets, reported by Qazinform.
The artificial intelligence buildout's carbon bill could add 618 million tons of CO2 by 2030, reversing 15 years of emissions cuts, reported by TechSpot.
Free artificial intelligence fluency courses have reached 1.1M users adopted by universities including UT Austin, reported by EdTech Innovation Hub.
New York passes laws to block harmful artificial intelligence chatbots and secure baby monitors for children, reported by Bee Group Newspapers.
Free every hour.
